name: @cordis-app/tool-gmail-browser
description: Gmail in a real browser: registers a small set of agent tools that drive the `playwright-mcp` compose service over MCP, with navigation restricted to Gmail. Entirely original to this project.
comment_dependencies: Deliberately none here beyond the cordis peer — see packages/llm/openai-compat/package.json's own comment_dependencies for the real prior bug this avoids. @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools and the rest are declared once, at the root package.json, and resolve here through the single hoisted root node_modules.
